overview: The Medford School Committee held its annual organizational meeting to elect officers before taking up routine business, including district enrollment demographics, PARCC testing plans, and new student restraint and Narcan administration protocols.

items.title: Election of Officers
items.summary: The committee elected Robert Emmett Skerry as secretary and Erin DiBenedetto as vice chair during its annual organizational meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes, Bills, and Payrolls
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the December 21, 2015 meeting alongside routine bill transfers and payrolls.

items.title: Acceptance of Donation to Columbus Elementary School
items.summary: The committee accepted an anonymous $2,500 donation to Columbus Elementary School intended for library technology and e-readers.

items.title: Acceptance of Gift for High School Robotics Team
items.summary: The committee accepted a recurring donation from Mighty Technologies to fund registration fees for the high school and vocational Botball robotics team.

items.title: Report on Enrollment, Demographics, and Class Sizes
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson presented a report detailing a district enrollment of 4,462 students, and the committee requested cost estimates to make all kindergarten aides full-time.

items.title: Report on PARCC Testing and Parent Notification
items.summary: Deputy Superintendent Beverly Nelson outlined plans to administer PARCC testing in spring 2016 to prepare students for the state's transition to MCAS 2.0.

items.title: Report on ELL Population and ACCESS Testing
items.summary: English Language Learner staff reported on mandatory online ACCESS testing and rising ELL student enrollment, particularly in secondary newcomer classes.

items.title: Approval of Revised Student Restraint Policy
items.summary: The committee approved an updated physical restraint and behavior support policy aligned with revised state regulations emphasizing de-escalation.

items.title: Approval of Opioid Overdose Prevention Protocol
items.summary: The committee approved a new clinical protocol allowing trained school nurses to administer Narcan in the event of a life-threatening opioid overdose.

items.title: Report on March Professional Development Day
items.summary: The committee accepted a report scheduling a teacher professional development day for March 1, 2016, with no school for students.

items.title: Resolutions and Executive Session
items.summary: The committee passed condolence resolutions for Benjamin Nickerson and Judge Henry Tamponi before voting to enter executive session to discuss personnel discipline and collective bargaining.
